messages:
OpsBot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT ALERT: p99 latency breach observed on continuous-batcher path in us-west1. p99 ~ 4.1s (SLO 1.0s). Increased streaming stalls and a spike in tail latency across mixed-seq workloads. Auto-alert triggered at 2024-04-15T19:05:33Z. Dashboards: https://dash.redwood.internal/contbatch/us-west1

Maya: I'm on it. Paging Sahil and Jo. Quick question — any recent config rollouts to cont-batcher in us-west1 in the last hour?

Sahil: I didn't roll anything in the last hour. Noted the burst around 19:03. Looks like mixed-seqlen requests skyrocketed for a few tenants.

Jo: Seeing increased pack sizes in traces, lots of padding for short requests being coalesced with very long ones. That amplification pattern matches prior padding-amplification issue. Customer impact: a handful of streaming sessions timed out at ~6s, some retries. No 5xxs, just latency/timeouts on front-end clients.

Maya: Ok. Immediate mitigation options: 1) reduce cont-batcher max_pack_size to lower batching depth; 2) enable preemptive-pack-shed for long sequences; 3) route high-variance tenants to dedicated streaming fallback pool. Let's triage order.

Lee: Recommend toggling preemptive pack shed first — low risk. Patch flag: `enable_preemptive_pack_shed=true` on scheduler. Also drop `batch_max_size` from 64->32 as a follow-up if needed.

Sahil: Applying preemptive pack shed now on us-west1 scheduler group A. Command:```\n# toggle feature flag on scheduler\ncurl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN' \\\n  https://ops-api.redwood.internal/scheduler/us-west1/groupA/flags \\\n  -d '{"enable_preemptive_pack_shed": true}'\n```

Sahil: Done — change pushed at 2024-04-15T19:08:05Z. Observability: enabling trace logs for cont-batcher with short window.

Maya: Watching p95/p99 now. Jo can you surface affected tenants list and raise to CSE if customers show user-facing errors?

Jo: Pulling tenant list. Early list: tenant-omega, tenant-sparrow, tenant-beta-prod. I DM'd CS with a heads-up and suggested temporary retry/backoff guidance.

KT: Noted that streaming stalls correlate with KV cache evictions on those hosts. Might be KV churn due to long seqs eating cache. We can nudge `kv_ttl` lower and increase `kv_capacity` on affected pods as a quick mitigation.

Sahil: After preemptive shed we see p99 drop from 4.1s -> 2.6s at 19:12. Still above SLO but improving. I'm going to reduce `batch_max_size` on groupA from 64->32. Applying now:```\nkubectl -n contbatch patch config/pack-config -p '{"spec":{"batch_max_size":32}}'\n```

Sahil: Patch applied at 19:14:40Z. Rolling to schedulers in 10s.

Maya: Great. Keep an eye on throughput impact (RPS). We don't want to cause overload/backpressure. Metrics: watch token emission rate and model QPS.

Lee: After batch_max_size reduction, p99 at 19:20 is 0.98s on us-west1 (under SLO). p95 also back to normal. KV eviction rate decreased. Looks stable so far.

Jo: CS confirmed degraded experience for ~7 active user sessions across the three tenants; no revenue-impacting errors reported. CS will follow up with customers: we informed them about transient latency spike and a brief config change.

Maya: Good. Next steps: 1) revert risky changes only if stable for 30m; 2) prepare a follow-up postmortem; 3) assign long-term fix: scheduler should avoid mixing very long and very short sequences in same pack (sequence bucketing).

Sahil: I'll open a PR for sequence bucketing heuristic and add unit tests. Short-term action item: implement tenant isolation rule for top offenders.

KT: I'll add a metric for pack-size distribution and a regression alert if 99th percentile pack_size > 40 for >5m. That should catch this earlier.

Maya: Assign postmortem owner? Jo take it?

Jo: I can own the postmortem. I'll collect traces and put draft in #postmortems. Action items: scheduling heuristic, KV tuning, pack_size alert, and docs for on-call mitigation playbook.

Lee: Note for follow-up: consider per-tenant pack caps and an emergency routing policy to fallback-serving (lower-latency smaller models) for streaming until cont-batcher load settles.

OpsBot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations applied: preemptive_pack_shed=true, batch_max_size=32. p99 returned below SLO at 19:20:12Z. Monitoring continues.

Maya: Handoff — I'm staying on for 15 more minutes. After that Sahil will take primary until steady state for 30m. Sahil please ack when you take over.

Sahil: Ack, taking over at 19:35. I'll run the tenant isolation rule and monitor.

Jo: I'll start the postmortem template and add timeline + affected tenants. Collecting links: traces: https://traces.redwood.internal/trace/abcd1234, metrics dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/contbatch/us-west1?range=1h

Maya: Thanks everyone. No customer data loss detected. Keep paging if regressions appear.

KT: Logging follow-ups in the incident board (INC-2024-042) and scheduling a sync with platform team tomorrow to scope the scheduler changes.

OpsBot: INCIDENT RESOLVED (monitoring): p99 below SLO for 30m. Incident auto-closed at 2024-04-15T19:45:67Z.

Sahil: Closing note — temporary config changes: `enable_preemptive_pack_shed=true` (keep for now), `batch_max_size=32` (re-evaluate after postmortem). I'll include rollback plan in the runbook.

Jo: Postmortem owner: Jo. ETA first draft: 2024-04-16 EOD.

Maya: Thanks all, great quick mitigation and coordination.

(ends)
